notes.title: Patch 07-12-2023
notes.content:
- The new "System Portal" was opened in Downtown.
- [b]Sky Tower[/b] can be accessed through the System Portal.
- [b]Ice Wall Mountain[/b] can be accessed through the System Portal.
- Driving camera update. More stable and more snappy.
- Minor reflections fixed in some areas including the login screen and customizing garage.

Please stay tuned for more maps to come!

notes.title: Hotfix 31-08-2023
notes.content:
- Increase event items rate.
- Fix the Tsunami's event progressing.
- Fix GT4R in online maps.
- Removed the 'Welcome Gift' event.

notes.title: Patch 27-08-2023
notes.content:
Harness the raw power of fire and water in our limited-time event!

Use the in-game items; Fire Burst and Tsunami items to earn elemental medals.
Dive into battles, embrace the heat, and ride the waves to victory!

Event period: 29 August - 28 September 2023

Rewards:
- GT4R
- Elemental Wheel
- Aquarium Animated Decal
- Flame Animated Decal

Update Log:
- Preparing for the upcoming event: Elemental Convergence Event.

- Added new wheel: Elemental Wheel.
- Added new items: Fire Burst (Event), and Tsunami (Event).

notes.title: Welcome Gift Event
notes.content:
As a welcome gift, we have planned an event for you to collect the particular car, decal, drift effect, and wheels.

Purple Gifts and Blue Gifts appear all around Uptown in this period of time, collect them and exchange the prizes with the NPCs Downtown!

Event Period: 28th July - 28th August 2023

notes.title: Uptown Outbreak is now available on Steam!
notes.content:
Uptown Outbreak is now available on Steam!

Thank you everybody for your long wait and support!
